summary: Round-2 backend/scalar repair; every owned census class is at zero and the lowered forms execute and compare. (1) Batched/two-axis tl.dot: the block-pointer desugar now produces the source's DECLARED rank-2 block shape (the old rank-1 flattening was shape-agnostic and a (slow,fast)-ordered tile transposed every block whose order places the minor axis first -- matmul_abt's A tile, order=(1,0)); the shared arange is region-scoped (a closed region's arange no longer leaks across loop bodies); tl.advance folds zero deltas so untouched axes stay at their channel (the loop's channel-drop then does not carry them); the loop body's block-pointer descriptor is rebuilt over the carried channel terms (previously every iteration re-read the pre-header offsets -- the accumulated dot saw the first K block once per iteration), and derived_terms now include compile-time terms so a constant-offset advance axis rides the loop too; c_ptrs.dtype.element_ty resolves through the lowering symbols. matmul_kernel_1334dd27 (fp16 IME, fp32, bf16) and matmul_abt (fp32, bf16) execute and compare PASS at 1 and 4 workers; grouped_mm/grouped_gemm now refuse located at the GRID (tile-count sums over symbolic-bound ranges the expression language cannot carry) -- the dot no longer refuses. (2) fp16/16-bit atomics: a sub-word synthesis (aligned 32-bit word lr/sc retry loop, the neighbouring half preserved, the declared RVWMO aq/rl suffixes on the pair) for fp16/bf16/int16 pointees, fp arithmetic in fp32 with one RTNE back; the atomic loop's extracts/slides/mask state are region-managed; the emitted parallel move for m1 vector params is the whole-register vmv1r.v (vmv.v.v copied only avl elements at the ambient region -- a mixed-SEW pass's e16 ambient copied 64 of an i32 vector's 128 bytes and the fp16 atomic's offset/mask params arrived half-swapped, firing lanes 16+ out of range). scatter_atomic fp16 executes and compares at 1/2/4/8 workers (cross-program accumulation), weighted_scatter/splitk/f_init/conv1x1 fp16 at 1 and 4; the fp16 guard-region witness: real build intact, degraded build corrupts. (3) Scalar widths: sub-32 scalar widening rides the vector lane (splat/vwiden/extract); mixed-width scalar pairs widen to the declared computation width at the binop/compare dispatch (compares floor at 32 -- the scalar core has no sub-32 rows); a re-materialized floating comparison rides the splat-compare-extract form (pdist's if p_val == 0.0); the frontend records the if's per-arm join SIDES on the node and the MIR arm close reads them (the alias-driven name environment resolved one arm's join side to the sibling's value -- pdist's hi = mid in the else arm aliased mid as hi everywhere, the then arm closed with mid as its hi side and the binary search collapsed to one iteration); a chunked region whose escaping loop-exit join has no merge rule now refuses located (logsumexp's maximum over a 1024-lane block was silently overwritten per chunk -- stored -inf). (4) The two T018-named defects: sym_constrain_range int64 compiles and executes+compares (the scalar_store VectorType crash is gone; regression test) and sgn_real bf16 builds an artifact and executes+compares (the bool->16-bit-float convert pins v0 immediately before its select -- the early pin's live range spanned the arms' internal v0 pins and the allocator refused with two fixed v0 masks live). The full a100c test suite passes (37 pre-existing files, test_atomics' grouped_gemm boundary updated to the moved located refusal) plus the new test_t034_repairs.py with 10 executed checks; the filtered sweep over the 12 owned operators: 47 artifacts + 17 located refusals of OTHER constructs (grid/allocation/loop) + 0 crashes, all checks PASS; a wide 600-case sweep over the corpus: 373 artifacts + 64 located refusals + 0 crashes, all checks PASS.
